newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda Chemical to boost overseas workforce.
newsitem.headline: Takeda Chemical to boost overseas workforce.

text.p: Japan's largest drug maker, Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd, said on Tuesday that it plans to boost its overseas workforce to 5,000 from the current 3,000 in eight years.
Concurrently, the company aims to cut its domestic payroll by about 2,800 from 10,300 at present.

A company spokesman said that the moves are in response to increasingly difficult business conditions in Japan, where the government is lowering drug prices in an effort to curb surging medical costs.
"We are putting emphasis on developing business in the United States, which is the world's largest market for pharmaceuticals," said the spokesman.

In recent sessions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, shares in Japanese pharmaceutical firms, including Takeda, gained ground as investors bought shares in defensive sectors which are relatively unaffected by economic and currency fluctuations.
